title: AI News Daily — August 18, 2026
summary: Anthropic's annualized revenue rocketed past $65 billion — seven times its pace at the start of the year — as the company works toward a possible IPO. Meanwhile, Z.ai's new GLM-5.3 turned out sharper at finding exploits than its trainers intended, flagging a real vulnerability in Cursor. And Cursor itself launched Origin, a code-hosting platform, the same day a six-hour GitHub outage underscored the opening it's chasing.
